_comment: Squad Building Challenge rules: how the authored sbc.json vocabulary (requirement rules, reward entries) becomes the client's elgReq and awards contract.
_rewardPacksComment: sbc.json reward pack keys to reward pack ids. Numeric legacy keys use legacyRewardPacks; anything unknown becomes defaultRewardPack. A player_pick reward on a set whose key names a rating (UP_84, ..._86+) delivers the matching packs.json playerPickPacks entry.
_imagesComment: Set and challenge trophy art: imageIdBase plus the set id's offset from the first set id (900000). Set tiles are served from artFolder as <set id>.png, falling back to the set tab's tab-<tabId>.png (tab-<fallbackTabId> for unknown sets). The RARE rule is PLAYER_RARITY_GROUP 4: PLAYER_RARITY would match rareflag 1 exactly and reject special cards.
_requirementsComment: Requirement rule types. bound names the attribute holding the rule's number (min, max, or the quality name for value). eligibilityKey and scope are the client's SBCEligibilityKey and SCOPE names; a rule without eligibilityKey only appears in the description. A fixed eligibilityValue turns the bound into the player count. exact applies when the rule has an exact count between 1 and squadSize. {value} in a label is replaced by the rule's number, exact count or title-cased quality.
